'''Lorgatt''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] member of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|Kajidic]]. He oversaw the mining operations on the Hutt [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Varl/Legends|Varl]]. He reported directly to the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]], but also embezzled money from the operations that [[Gender/Legends|he]] oversaw.<ref name="LoNH" />
